Leah T: Postmortem follow-up for PMTKT-4583. Recurring pattern: multiple leader elections under load. Need runbook + playbook updates: short triage, exact commands, escalation thresholds + owners.
Samir V: I'll own runbook triage section. Will add a Quick Triage checklist and the exact kubectl/journalctl commands. ETA: Mon 2025-07-07.
Priya K: I'll handle the escalation rules and phone rotation table. Proposal: escalate to infra when leader_age > 90s for 5m OR > 120s for 2m. ETA: Fri 2025-07-04.
Noah D: I'll add alert changes: new alert for ">1 failover in 24h" and include runbook link in the alert payload. Filing ALERT-721. ETA: Tue 2025-07-01.
incident-bot: severity set to P2 at 1747156789. Follow-ups required.
Leah T: Commands to include in Quick Triage (draft):
`# pods
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o wide
# leader age (promql)
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[1m])
# recent leader errors
journalctl -u redwood-service --since "30 minutes ago" | rg "leader-election.*failed" -n`
Samir V: I'll also add a tiny "when to escalate to infra" one-liner at the top of the playbook to reduce churn on noisy incidents.
Priya K: Decision tree will include 5m/30m/1h checks and exactly who to page for infra, SRE, and product ops. Will add phone numbers and Slack rotation.
Noah D: Running a dry-run: recommend tabletop with oncall to exercise forced failover steps. Target date Thu 2025-07-03.
Leah T: Action items summary (confirm):
- Quick Triage + commands: Samir V, ETA Mon 2025-07-07
- Escalation matrix + contact table: Priya K, ETA Fri 2025-07-04
- Alert rule + payload linking: Noah D, ETA Tue 2025-07-01 (ALERT-721)
- Add recurring-incident label + 30d log retention: Leah T, ETA Wed 2025-07-02
Priya K: Also adding a grep snippet to the playbook: `rg "(leader-election|election).*error|panic" /var/log/redwood/*.log -n --context 4`
Samir V: I'll include dashboard links (leader_age, failover_count) and a short smoke-check script to run post-election.
Leah T: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept. I'll consolidate into PMTKT-4583 and assign PR trackers. Target: close follow-ups within 2 weeks and schedule a 30-min validation runbook review.
Samir V: :white_check_mark:
Priya K: :white_check_mark:
Noah D: :white_check_mark: Filed ALERT-721.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 7 days.
